{{Quote|Myrgaanti was one of the finest warriors I ever met—cunning, quick-thinking, skilled, unpredictable, and physically overbearing.|General Airen Cracken|<ref name="SWAJ6" />}}
'''Myrgaanti Shi-Iki''' was a [[Gorvan Horansi|Gorvan]] [[Horansi]] member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecForce]] [[Infiltrators/Legends|Infiltrators]]. He and his longtime friend and fellow Infiltrator [[Bryce Agoris]] deserted the Rebellion shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], taking over two million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] of matériel with them, including the prototype of the [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr]] [[VGK-3 Shooting Star class starfighter|VGK-3 Shooting Star]]. Shi-Iki became [[Wanted by Cracken|wanted]] by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Chief of Intelligence/Legends|Chief of Intelligence]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]].<ref name="SWAJ6" />
